name: return_control_prefetch
title: 返回小控制提前一级读取
source_stage: PIPELINE-2 for the existing P>1 scheduled branch
debug_tag_and_assertions: separate always blocks under ifndef SYNTHESIS
safety_argument: At most one in-flight token per context tag; valid prior and last stage cannot both own the same tag.
Acceptance writes the context before its token can reach prior stage; P2 prior stage0 metadata was written on the preceding edge.

Returned-tag phase/iteration updates cannot collide with a different token of that tag in prior stage. Same-edge feedback creates a new stage0 token whose updated metadata is visible before its later prior-stage read.
Common family/coordinates still remain shared until busy contexts and captured results drain; they are not prefetched.
risk: Splits returned tag-to-small-control selection path, but data-bank and initial digit/formatter paths remain. Area/Fmax improvements require actual common measurements.
